items.name: motion-kit
items.origin: Adapted motion mechanics from preserved HyperFrames catalog originals; project glue by Evoquex.

items.name: evoquex-v12-effects
items.origin: Mechanics adapted from pinned HyperFrames catalogue, source archives and Apache2 license preserved. Rectangles are explicit, no async layout reads.
items.limits: CSS2.5D only; flipBox counter-scale selected children; no physics/reflow. Native host render validation required.

items.name: evoquex-v13-motion

api.e85: e85(normalizedProgress) -> easedProgress. Cubic-bezier(.85,0,.15,1), solved by24 bisection iterations; use progress0..1.
api.glyphs: glyphs() -> void. Synchronously replaces text of [data-letters] with span.vchar nodes and keeps original text as aria-label; call once before timeline construction.
api.letters: letters(timeline, containerSelector, atSeconds, {x=12,y=100,rot=65,tilt=3,duration=.46,ease="power4.out",stagger=.018}) -> void. One entrance per generated glyph, alternating lateral offset/X/Z rotation.
api.slices: slices(timeline, containerSelector, atSeconds, {distance=130,duration=.5,ease="back.out(1.08)"}) -> void. Exactly3 DOM children.slice; authored y/rotation arrays and35ms offsets recombine the complementary clipped planes.
api.frame: frame(timeline, svgRectAttributeObject, atSeconds, duration=.6) -> void. Tweens attributes of the host #flow-frame SVG rect using e85; fixed global target is intentional.

catalogue_origins.name: text-match-cut
catalogue_origins.mechanic: E85 single smooth motion curve, here24 bisection iterations rather than upstream28.

catalogue_origins.name: pan-stations
catalogue_origins.mechanic: Continuous host world/strip with staged camera stops. Host motion.js owns camera changes; helper does not implement a full station generator.

catalogue_origins.name: type-match-cut
catalogue_origins.mechanic: Type and complementary aperture linked to media-boundary transformation; explicit host clipping/layout needed.

catalogue_origins.name: slit-scan-reveal
catalogue_origins.mechanic: Fragmented temporal arrival followed by coherent resolve adapted as3 clipped DOM planes. This is not the literal96-band Canvas time-sampling renderer.

items.upstream_license: Apache-2.0; full text in biblioteca/hyperframes/LICENSE. GSAP retains its separate vendor license. Local project adaptation does not assert licensing of pack media.
limits: glyphs mutates DOM; not repeat-safe after composition construction unless host recreates original text.
letters selector must address one container; do not pass an ungrouped comma list. The caller owns line breaks, clipping and timeline/initial-state interactions.
slices supports exactly3 children; more children would exceed the authored arrays. It does not subdivide text/images or set masks automatically.
frame is coupled to one SVG rect ID and changes SVG geometry, not CSS layout boxes.
No own timeline registration, audio/media playback, clocks, async font measurements or physics simulation. Host owns deterministic registration and visual acceptance.
items.validation_status: Source copied bit-identically from stable V13 host; final render motion review is separate, not inferred from syntax or catalogue registration.

historical_reuse.notes: Pearlescent lens, original filming plane, focus wordmark, self-contained licensed audio inputs.
